body: go module pitviper initialized. internal/vterm: VT100 screen state machine with SGR colors, cursor movement, scrollback (8 tests pass). internal/pty: openpty via /dev/ptmx + TIOCSWINSZ. internal/font: 8x13 glyph atlas via x/image/font/basicfont. cmd/pitviper/main.go: SDL2 window + PTY + 60fps render loop. Blocked on: sudo apt install libsdl2-dev to build the binary.
title: S45-02: PITVIPER Milestone 1 — SDL2 terminal scaffold (PTY + vterm + glyph atlas)
